letsfg.description: Flight and hotel search & booking for AI agents. Server-side engine covers hundreds of airlines with per-flight reliability history, plus real bookable hotel rates with free cancellation and pay-later terms. Flights book for real: the fare is held on the connected card, a LetsFG booking agent buys the ticket, and the hold is captured only against a real PNR. ONE credential covers both: the card-backed token from the connect flow (put it in LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN) or a Developer API key. Connect through the hosted MCP at https://letsfg.co/developers/api/mcp: the consent step opens letsfg.co/connect, where a card is saved in a 0.00 Revolut setup (nothing charged). The token you get is card-backed and can book. Hotels use the same card, and booking one charges a 5% non-refundable reservation fee, balance paid to the supplier by balance_due_by.
